reading.body:
Evocative operates a confirmed facility at Harmon Cove in Secaucus, New Jersey, one of 24 data centers the company runs across 14 metropolitan areas. The facility's published specifications do not include total capacity in megawatts, IT load, or racks, making it impossible to assess its scale for AI workloads against the operator's broader footprint or other sites.

New Jersey has 48 mapped data center facilities of which only 5 publish power capacity figures totaling 111.3 MW. This Secaucus site ranks sixth among published capacity in the state, but since its own capacity is not published, that ranking reflects other facilities' disclosed figures and leaves the actual distribution of the state's AI infrastructure unclear.

Without published power specifications, this campus cannot be evaluated against the binding constraint of compute scaling. Its location in the densest metro corridor on the East Coast and proximity to major markets may matter operationally, but the absence of capacity data means its significance to AI deployment decisions remains unknown from public sources.
